basics.description: **QCrypton PQC Scanner** — post-quantum readiness for Microsoft Sentinel. Scans your Azure subscriptions for quantum-vulnerable cryptography (RSA/ECC in Key Vault, classical TLS certs on public endpoints, storage/App Service TLS posture) and surfaces findings as Microsoft Sentinel analytics rules, workbook, and playbook.
